text:
toni: quick heads-up: nightly showed a token alignment regression for sdk-3.x with runtime-4.2 on some trimmed-chat prompts in APAC canary. small rate (~0.18%) but visible diffs in downstream ranking. thinking we should soft-pin routing for cohort `trimmed-apac` to runtime-4.1 during the 01:00 UTC window while we investigate.
mike: agree on soft-pin. can we gate on `token_align_delta >= 0.15%` OR `ranking_mismatch_rate >= 0.1%` over 20m?
sre-ada: add cpu guard: abort if host cpu > 88% for 5m. also want an explicit TTL for the pin (2h) and auto-rollforward rule if metrics improve for 30m.
deploybot: deploybot: ready to schedule on confirmation. need group id, target runtime, start_ts, ttl_s, gate.
qa-lee: i'll run preflight at T-40m on 1.5k prompts and post results.
doc-kim: i'll draft release note blurb and add support FAQ pointer.
toni: proposed: start_ts=1729999600 (01:00 UTC), ttl_s=7200, gate as above, auto-unpin after metrics clear 30m. tag in pinlist.csv=`apac-trim-compat-2024`.
mike: confirm soft pin only, no infra changes.
deploybot: deploybot: scheduled soft pin `pin-1729998888` for `trimmed-apac` -> `runtime-4.1`. start=1729999600, ttl=7200s, rollback=auto-rollforward-metrics30m.
qa-lee: preflight at 00:20 UTC: token_align_delta=0.16% (4.2 vs 4.1), ranking_mismatch=0.08% on sample. marginal but I recommend proceeding with pin. artifacts: ci/internal/artifacts/trimmed-apac/1729998888.
sre-ada: cpu guard configured; pager hooked to oncall.
doc-kim: PR https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/945 drafted with blurb and workaround (pin to 4.1).
toni: thanks all. proceeding to create calendar event and will post post-window telemetry snapshot in this thread.
